settings.heading: How We Restore, Test & Certify Every Item
settings.body_text: At Unboxed, every product we sell – from smartphones and laptops to fine jewellery – goes through a rigorous refurbishment and quality control process. We don't simply resell pre-owned items. Each product is professionally inspected, restored, tested, and verified to meet our performance, safety, and quality standards. Only items that pass every stage of our process are approved for sale.
settings.trust_point_2: Fully tested for performance and safety
settings.trust_point_3: Restored and cleaned to a high standard

settings.title: Our 5-Stage Tech Refurbishment Process
settings.intro_text: Every device undergoes rigorous testing and restoration. Only products that pass all five stages are approved for sale, ensuring you receive quality you can trust.
settings.step_1_description: Devices are logged, verified as genuine, checked against databases, and assessed for physical condition.
settings.step_2_description: Comprehensive hardware and software tests including battery health, screen, cameras, connectivity, sensors, and performance.
settings.step_3_description: Faulty components replaced, firmware updated, and full functionality restored to manufacturer standards.
settings.step_4_description: Devices deep cleaned, sanitised, securely wiped of all previous data, and reset to factory settings.
settings.step_5_description: Re-tested, visually inspected, assigned a condition grade, and approved for sale with our quality guarantee.

settings.intro_text: Every piece of jewellery sold by Unboxed is professionally inspected, authenticated, cleaned, and restored before being listed for sale. Our expert team ensures each item meets the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.
settings.step_1_description: Each piece is carefully examined by our experts to verify authenticity, hallmarks, and precious metal content.
settings.step_2_description: Using specialist techniques and equipment, we restore the original lustre and brilliance to every piece.
settings.step_3_description: All gemstones and settings are thoroughly checked and secured to ensure they meet our exacting standards.
settings.step_4_description: A comprehensive final inspection ensures every piece meets our premium quality standards before listing.

settings.intro_text: All our refurbished products are fully functional and professionally tested. The only difference between grades is cosmetic appearance—performance is identical across all conditions.
settings.grade_1_summary: Pristine condition with minimal to no signs of use
settings.grade_1_point_1: No visible scratches or marks on screen or body
settings.grade_1_point_2: May have very minor micro-scratches only visible under direct light
settings.grade_1_point_3: Perfect for those who want near-new aesthetics
settings.grade_1_point_4: Ideal for gifts or personal premium use
settings.grade_2_summary: Light signs of use with excellent overall appearance
settings.grade_2_point_1: Minor surface scratches or light scuffs on body
settings.grade_2_point_2: Screen is clear with no noticeable marks during use
settings.grade_2_point_3: Great balance of quality and value
settings.grade_2_point_4: Best for everyday use and practical buyers
settings.grade_3_summary: Visible wear but fully functional and reliable
settings.grade_3_point_1: Noticeable scratches, scuffs, or dents on body
settings.grade_3_point_2: Screen may have light scratches but remains fully usable
settings.grade_3_point_4: Perfect for those prioritising function over appearance
